title: PsyAgent: Constructing Human-like Agents Based on Psychological Modeling and Contextual Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2601.06158v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human-like agents must express stable dispositions while adapting to roles, relationships, and norms. We present PsyAgent, a schema-first framework that operationalizes the trait-context interface by coupling a Big Five trait prior with explicit social-structural conditioning. PsyAgent comprises (i) Individual Structure (IS), a machine-usable trait-grounded profile, and (ii) Multi-Scenario Contexting (MSC), a curated library of role-relationship-norm frames spanning eight everyday arenas. At inference, fixed structured prompts couple the active MSC frame with the IS profile, encouraging behavior that is stable yet context-sensitive. To demonstrate learnability beyond prompt engineering, we use IS x MSC to synthesize supervision and fine-tune compact backbones with PEFT (SFT and optional DPO). translated_title: PsyAgent：基于心理建模与情境交互的类人智能体构建
translated_abstract: 类人智能体必须在表达稳定人格特质的同时适应角色、关系与规范。我们提出PsyAgent，这是一个“模式优先”（schema-first）框架，通过将大五人格特质先验与显式的社会结构条件化相结合，实现了特质—情境接口的可操作化。PsyAgent包含两个部分：(i) 个体结构，一个机器可用的、以特质为基础的画像；(ii) 多情境化，一个涵盖八个日常生活领域的角色—关系—规范框架精选库。在推理阶段，固定的结构化提示将激活的MSC框架与IS画像相结合，从而促使智能体的行为既保持稳定又对情境敏感。为了证明其可学习性超越了单纯的提示工程，我们利用IS×MSC合成监督数据，并采用参数高效微调技术（PEFT，包括SFT及可选的DPO）对紧凑型骨干模型进行微调。在百分位空间下受控的心理测量式评估协议中，PsyAgent提升了特质忠实度与多轮人设一致性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PsyAgent提出了一种“模式优先”框架，将大五人格特质画像（IS）与多情境化框架（MSC）耦合，并利用两者组合合成监督数据微调紧凑模型，使类人智能体的行为既保持人格稳定又能随情境灵活变化。
en_tdlr: PsyAgent introduces a schema-first framework that couples Big Five trait-grounded profiles (IS) with multi-scenario role-relationship-norm frames (MSC), synthesizing supervision to fine-tune compact models so that human-like agents exhibit behavior that is both trait-stable and context-sensitive.
